l-e-e4-b01-01.title: Adjective ọ̀ na-abịa tupu noun mgbe niile?
l-e-e4-b01-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "An adjective always comes before a noun" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere) ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: An adjective (okwu na-akọwa otú ihe si dị) always comes right before a noun. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: small dị tupu cat. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: Adjective dị tupu noun. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: red dị tupu bag. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-01.s.s1.explain: N'The soup is hot., hot adịghị tupu noun kama ọ dị mgbe is. Adjective nwere ike ịbịa mgbe be verbs nakwa.
l-e-e4-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: N'The soup is hot., hot dị mgbe is, ọ bụghị tupu soup, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e4-b01-02.title: In ọ̀ pụtara 'n'ime' mgbe niile?
l-e-e4-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "in always means 'inside'" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere) ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: The preposition in always has the place meaning 'inside'. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere ihe ebe pụtara 'n'ime ụlọ'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere ihe ebe pụtara 'n'ime igbe'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere ihe ebe pụtara 'n'ime akpa'. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s1.explain: in the morning na-agwa oge, 'n'ụtụtụ'. Anyị na-eji in maka oge nakwa, ọ bụghị naanị maka ebe.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: in the morning na-agwa oge, 'n'ụtụtụ', ọ bụghị ebe, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e4-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: A na-ejikwa in maka oge, ya mere in the morning bụ ihe atụ megidere nye 'n'ime'.

l-e-e4-b01-03.title: Ajụjụ niile ọ̀ na-amalite na Do?
l-e-e4-b01-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "All English questions start with Do" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere) ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b01-03.material: Nkwupụta: All English questions (ajụjụ a na-aza site na Yes/No) start with Do. Chọta ajụjụ na-emegide nkwupụta a.

l-e-e4-b01-04.title: Ọnụọgụ ọ̀ bụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ mgbe niile?
l-e-e4-b01-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "A number word always means a number of people" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere) ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: When a number word (two, three...) appears in a text, it always means how many people. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s1.r.a: six bụ ọnụọgụ ụmụaka. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s1.r.c: two bụ ọnụọgụ ụmụ nwoke. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s1.r.d: five bụ ọnụọgụ ndị na-abụ abụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s1.explain: three bụ ọnụọgụ nkịta. Ọnụọgụ na-agwa ọnụọgụ anụmanụ na ihe, ọ bụghị naanị mmadụ.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s2.model.0: three na-agwa ọnụọgụ nkịta, ọ bụghị mmadụ, ya mere nkwupụta na ọnụọgụ bụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ mgbe niile ezighi ezi.
l-e-e4-b01-04.s.s2.model.1: N'I have three dogs., three na-agụ nkịta, ya mere ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ mmadụ.

l-e-e4-b01-05.title: Yesterday ọ̀ pụtara -ed?
l-e-e4-b01-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "A sentence with yesterday has a verb ending in -ed" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere) ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: A sentence with yesterday has a verb that always ends in -ed. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b01-05.s.s1.r.b: walked na-akwụsị na -ed. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-05.s.s1.r.c: cleaned na-akwụsị na -ed. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-05.s.s1.r.d: played na-akwụsị na -ed. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-05.s.s1.explain: ate anaghị akwụsị na -ed, ma ọ bụ ụdị oge gara aga nke eat. Ụfọdụ verbs oge gara aga na-agbanwe ụdị ha.
l-e-e4-b01-05.s.s2.model.0: ate bụ banyere ụnyaahụ ma anaghị akwụsị na -ed, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.

l-e-e4-b02-01.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe e nwere otu ihe, ị na-eji a mgbe niile tupu ya. Chọta nkwuwa okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: A na-eji A tupu otu anụmanụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.

l-e-e4-b02-01.s.s1.explain: Egg na-amalite site n'ụda vowel /e/, ya mere ị na-eji an. Ọbụlagodi maka otu, oge ụfọdụ ị na-eji an.

l-e-e4-b02-02.title: On ọ̀ pụtara mgbe niile "n'elu"?
l-e-e4-b02-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "On pụtara mgbe niile 'n'elu'" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (counterexample).
l-e-e4-b02-02.material: Nkwupụta: Preposition on pụtara mgbe niile 'n'akụkụ elu' nke ihe. Chọta nkwuwa okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ pụtara na ọ nọ n'elu tebụl. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ pụtara na ọ nọ n'elu shelf. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ pụtara na ọ nọ n'elu desk. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-02.s.s1.explain: "on the wall" apụtaghị 'n'elu' mgbidi kama ejikọtara n'mgbidi. A na-ejikwa On pụta imetụ.
l-e-e4-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: Foto n'mgbidi anaghị anọ n'elu ya kama ọ na-emetụ elu mgbidi, ya mere "on the wall" bụ counterexample nye nkwupụta.

l-e-e4-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ị nwere ike iza site n'Yes ma ọ bụ No. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.

l-e-e4-b02-04.title: It ọ̀ bụ mgbe niile anụmanụ?
l-e-e4-b02-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Pronoun It na-ezo aka mgbe niile n'anụmanụ" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (counterexample).
l-e-e4-b02-04.material: Nkwupụta: N'ederede, It na-ezo aka mgbe niile n'anụmanụ. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s1.r.a: It na-ezo aka n'nwamba. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s1.r.c: It na-ezo aka n'nkịta. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s1.r.d: It na-ezo aka n'nnụnụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s1.explain: N'"It is cold today.", It abụghị anụmanụ kama ọ bụ ihu igwe. It nwekwara ike ịzo aka n'ihe ma ọ bụ ihu igwe.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s2.model.0: N'"It is cold today.", It bụ ihu igwe, ọ bụghị anụmanụ, ya mere nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi.
l-e-e4-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: A na-ejikwa ya mgbe a na-ekwu banyere ihu igwe, ya mere It anaghị ezo aka n'anụmanụ mgbe niile.

l-e-e4-b03-01.title: Ịtụnyere site na adjectives ọ̀ bụ -er mgbe niile?
l-e-e4-b03-01.goal: Kpee ikpe ma nkwupụta 'Okwu ịtụnyere ka a na-eme site n'ịgbakwunye -er mgbe niile' bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e4-b03-01.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe ị na-ekwu 'more ...' site na adjective, ị na-agbakwunye -er n'ọgwụgwụ mgbe niile. Chọta pair nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b03-01.s.s1.r.a: E gbakwunyere -er n'ọgwụgwụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b03-01.s.s1.r.b: E gbakwunyere -er n'ọgwụgwụ. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-e4-b05-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Always use in before a time of day" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b05-02.material: Nkwupụta: When talking about a time of day, always use in. Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b05-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-eji in. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-eji in. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-eji in. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-02.s.s1.explain: Tupu night, jiri at, ya mere anyị na-ekwu at night. Jiri in naanị tupu morning, afternoon, na evening.
l-e-e4-b05-02.s.s2.model.0: at night na-eji at, ọ bụghị in, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ bụ in mgbe niile tupu oge nke ụbọchị ezighi ezi.

l-e-e4-b05-03.title: Ajụjụ How niile ọ̀ na-ajụ banyere usoro?
l-e-e4-b05-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "All questions that start with How ask about a method" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b05-03.material: Nkwupụta: All questions that start with How ask how to do something (a method). Chọta ajụjụ na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b05-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ajụ otú e si ede okwu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ajụ otú e si emeghe ihe. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ajụ otú e si ala. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-03.s.s1.explain: How old is your dog? na-ajụ banyere afọ, ọ bụghị usoro. Ihe ọ na-ajụ na-agbanwe dabere n'okwu mgbe How.

l-e-e4-b05-04.topic: Akara ịkpọ òkù na mmetụta onye na-ede
l-e-e4-b05-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "All sentences with an exclamation mark (!) express anger" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b05-04.material: Nkwupụta: Every sentence that ends with an exclamation mark (!) means the writer is angry. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ nkwupụta iwe na-agwa mmadụ ka ọ ghara ịkụ mkpu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ nkwupụta iwe na-ekwu na a hụghị mkpọtụ n'anya. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ nkwupụta iwe na-agwa mmadụ ka ọ hapụ onye na-ekwu okwu naanị ya. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s1.explain: Hooray! I won the game! na-egosi ọṅụ nke imeri. A na-eji akara ịkpọ òkù mgbe a na-ekwu okwu n'ike ma ọ naghị egosi naanị iwe.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s2.model.0: Hooray! I won the game! na-egosi ọṅụ, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi ọbụlagodi na e nwere akara ịkpọ òkù.
l-e-e4-b05-04.s.s2.model.1: A na-ejikwa akara ịkpọ òkù maka ọṅụ, ya mere ikwu na ahịrịokwu ọ bụla nwere ya bụ iwe ezighi ezi.

l-e-e4-b05-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na now dị, verb ọ̀ nwere -ing?
l-e-e4-b05-05.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "A sentence that contains now (right now) has a verb with -ing" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-e4-b05-05.material: Nkwupụta: A sentence that contains now, nke pụtara 'n'oge a', always has a verb with -ing added. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: reading nwere -ing. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s1.r.c: raining nwere -ing. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: eating nwere -ing. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s1.explain: I am at home now. enweghị -ing. Mgbe a na-ekwu banyere ọnọdụ n'oge a, ị nwere ike iji naanị am, is, ma ọ bụ are.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: I am at home now. nwere now ma enweghị verb -ing, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighi ezi.
l-e-e4-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: A na-egosipụta ọnọdụ n'oge a site na be verb naanị, ya mere ọbụlagodi na now, -ing anaghị adị mgbe niile.

l-e-e4-b06-01.title: Okwu niile na-ejedebe na -ly hà bụ adverb?
l-e-e4-b06-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na okwu ọ bụla na-ejedebe na -ly bụ adverb na-akọwa omume ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-e4-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: N’asụsụ Bekee, okwu niile na-ejedebe na -ly bụ adverb na-akọwa omume. Chọta okwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ adverb pụtara “ngwa ngwa”. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ adverb pụtara “nwayọọ nwayọọ”. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ adverb pụtara “n’olu dara ụda”. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s1.explain: friendly (obiọma, mma) na-ejedebe na -ly, ma ọ bụ adjective na-akọwa ọdịdị mmadụ ma ọ bụ anụmanụ. Ọ bụghị ha niile bụ adverb.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: friendly na-ejedebe na -ly, ma ọ bụ adjective na-akọwa ọdịdị, ọ bụghị omume; ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-e4-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-akọwa aha, dị ka a friendly dog; ya mere ọ megidere nkwupụta na okwu -ly niile bụ adverb.

l-e-e4-b06-03.title: Okwu ajụjụ ọ̀ na-esochi mgbe niile site na do ma ọ bụ be?
l-e-e4-b06-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na okwu ajụjụ na-esochi mgbe niile site n'udi nke do ma ọ bụ be verb bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma kọwaa site n'ichọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-e4-b06-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ozugbo mgbe okwu ajụjụ dị ka What, Who, ma ọ bụ Why, do, does, did, ma ọ bụ be verb (is, are) dị mgbe niile. Chọta ajụjụ nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.a: Does na-abịa mgbe What. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.b: Are na-abịa mgbe How. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: Is na-abịa mgbe Why. Ọ dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.explain: N'Who opens the door?, Who bụ subject nke na-emeghe ọnụ ụzọ. N'ikpe a, verb opens na-abịa ozugbo mgbe ya, n'enweghị do.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: N'Who opens the door?, verb opens na-abịa mgbe Who, ọ bụghị do ma ọ bụ be, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe Who bụ subject, verb na-abịa ozugbo mgbe ya n'enweghị do, ya mere nkwupụta na do ma ọ bụ be na-abịa mgbe niile ezighị ezi.

l-e-e4-b07-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “okwu ọ bụla na-ejedebe na -ed bụ ngwaa na-ekwu ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-e4-b07-01.material: Nkwupụta: N’asụsụ Bekee, okwu ọ bụla na-ejedebe na -ed bụ ngwaa na-akọ ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-e4-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: Helped bụ ngwaa na-ekwu ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b07-01.s.s1.r.c: Jumped bụ ngwaa na-ekwu ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: Opened bụ ngwaa na-ekwu ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-akwado nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-e4-b07-01.s.s1.explain: Tired (ike gwụrụ) na-ejedebe na -ed, ma ọ bụ adjective na-akọ ọnọdụ. Ọ bụghị ngwaa na-ekwu ihe mmadụ mere n’oge gara aga.

l-e-e4-b07-01.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe am gasịrị, tired na-akọ ọnọdụ m, ọ bụghị ihe mere n’oge gara aga; ya mere ọ bụghị eziokwu na okwu -ed niile bụ ngwaa oge gara aga.

l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ihe a ga-eweta. Ị nweghị ike ịmata oge.
l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ otú a na-akpọ onye na-anata ndetu. Ị nweghị ike ịmata oge.
l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-agwa ebe nwa nọ. Ị nweghị ike ịmata oge.
l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s1.explain: Pick me up at 5. pụtara "bịa weta m na elekere 5". Ahịrị okwu ndị ọzọ bụ ebe na arịrịọ.
l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s2.model.0: Pick me up at 5. nwere oge 5, ya mere ị nwere ike ịmata oge ị ga-aga.
l-e-e4-b04-09.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị okwu ndị ọzọ na-agwa ebe ma ọ bụ ihe ma enweghị oge, ma naanị ahịrị okwu nwere at 5 na-agwa oge.

l-e-e4-b04-10.s.s1.r.b: Udi anụmanụ anaghị ekpebi udi ngwaa.
l-e-e4-b04-10.s.s1.r.c: Ihe ebe pụtara anaghị ekpebi udi ngwaa.
l-e-e4-b04-10.s.s1.explain: Look! na-atụ aka n'ihe na-eme n'ihu gị ugbu a. Ọ na-eme ugbu a, ya mere ọ bụ is running.

l-e-e4-b05-06.goal: Iji chọpụta okwu na-akọwa ụda, chọpụta ụkpụrụ (ozi) nke achọrọ n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-e4-b05-06.material: Ịchọrọ ịchịkọta naanị okwu na-akọwa ụda n'otu otu site n'okwu isii loud, sweet, quiet, sour, noisy, salty.
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu nwere okwu na-akọwa ụda?
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s1.r.a: sweet na-akọwa ụtọ, ọ bụghị ụda.
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-achịkọta okwu na-akọwa ụtọ. Ha abụghị banyere ụda.
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s1.explain: loud (na-akpa mkpọtụ buru ibu), quiet (na-akpa obere mkpọtụ), na noisy (jupụtara na mkpọtụ) na-akọwa ụda. Ndị ọzọ na-akọwa ụtọ.
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s2.model.0: loud, quiet, noisy niile na-agwa otú ụda dị, ya mere ha bụ otu ụda.
l-e-e4-b05-06.s.s2.model.1: sweet, sour, salty na-agwa banyere ụtọ, ya mere ha adịghị n'otu ụda.

l-e-e4-b05-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ekwu naanị ihe ị na-anya. Ọ naghị agwa ntụziaka nke ịga ụlọ akwụkwọ.

l-e-e4-b05-07.s.s1.explain: go bụ mmegharị gaa n'ebe ụfọdụ, ya mere jiri to, nke na-egosi ntụziaka. Mgbe ị na-anọ ọtọ, jiri at.

l-e-e4-b05-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na udi ederede.

l-e-e4-b05-10.material: Yesterday my dog ___ not eat. Anyị chọrọ ịhọrọ otu n'do, does, ma ọ bụ did maka oghere.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s1.o.a: na Yesterday pụtara oge gara aga
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s1.r.b: did nwere otu udi maka otu ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ, ya mere nke a adịghị mkpa.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s1.r.c: Ịmara na ọ bụ ngwaa anaghị ekpebi nke n'do, does, ma ọ bụ did ka a ga-eji.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ eziokwu na ọ na-adịghị mma, ma ọ naghị agwa udi oge kedu ka a ga-eji.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Yesterday bụ oge gara aga. Ọnọdụ na-adịghị mma nke ihe omume gara aga na-eji did not, nke bụ otu ma ihe na-eme ihe bụ otu ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s2.model.0: Ị chọrọ ịmara na Yesterday bụ oge gara aga iji họrọ did, ya mere oge dị mkpa kpamkpam ọnụọgụ nke ihe na-eme ihe adịghịkwa.
l-e-e4-b05-10.s.s2.model.1: Maka oge gara aga, anyị na-eji did, ya mere ihe dị mkpa bụ ma ọ bụ oge gara aga, ọ bụghị ma ọ bụ otu ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ.

l-e-e4-b06-06.material: I have ___ old hat. Ịchọrọ ịhọrọ ma a ma ọ bụ an maka oghere ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s1.o.b: Na have bụ n'udi ugbu a
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s1.r.b: Tense nke verb anaghị ekpebi n'etiti a na an.
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s1.o.c: Ma okwu na-esote, old, na-amalite na ụda vowel
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s1.r.d: A na an na-adabara okwu dị ozugbo mgbe ha. Okwu dị ozugbo mgbe bụ old.
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s1.explain: A na an na-ekpebi site n'ụda mbụ nke okwu dị ozugbo mgbe ha. Old na-amalite na ụda vowel, ya mere ọ bụ an old hat.
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s2.model.0: Ebe okwu na-esote, old, na-amalite na ụda vowel, ị pụrụ ịhọrọ an, ya mere ụda mbụ nke old dị mkpa n'ezie.
l-e-e4-b06-06.s.s2.model.1: A na an na-adabara okwu dị ozugbo mgbe ha, ya mere ị kwesịrị ilele old, ọ bụghị hat.

l-e-e4-b06-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma tunnel dị ogologo ma ọ bụ dị mkpụmkpụ
l-e-e4-b06-07.s.s1.o.d: Ụgbọ ole ụgbọ okporo ígwè nwere

l-e-e4-b06-08.material: ___ bag is this? Azịza bụ "It is mine." Ịchọrọ ịhọrọ otu n'ime Whose, Who, na What maka oghere ahụ.

l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.o.c: Na this na-atụ aka n'ihe dị nso
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ anaghị ekpebi n'etiti Whose na Who.

l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s2.model.1: Azịza na-agwa gị ihe na-ekpebi okwu ajụjụ, ya mere ị na-ele onye nwe ya.

l-e-e4-b06-09.goal: Kpebie ọkọlọtọ (ozi) ị chọrọ n'ezie iji họpụta okwu ndị na-egosi usoro, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-e4-b06-09.material: N'etiti okwu isii First, Because, Then, So, Next, na Finally, ịchọrọ ịnakọta naanị okwu ndị na-egosi usoro ihe merenụ.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu nwere naanị okwu ndị na-egosi usoro?
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.a: Because na-egosi ihe kpatara. Ọ bụghị banyere usoro.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.c: So na-egosi nsonaazụ. Ọ bụghị banyere usoro.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.d: Because na So na-egosi ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, ọ bụghị usoro.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.explain: First, Then, Next, na Finally na-egosi usoro. Because na-egosi ihe kpatara, ma So na-egosi nsonaazụ.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s2.model.0: First, Then, Next, na Finally niile na-egosi ihe na-abịa tupu na mgbe, ya mere ha bụ okwu usoro.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s2.model.1: Because na-egosi ihe kpatara ma So na-egosi nsonaazụ, ya mere ha adịghị n'otu na okwu usoro.

l-e-e4-b06-10.title: Ịnakọta verbs nke udi oge gara aga ha na-agbanwe
l-e-e4-b06-10.goal: Kpebie ọkọlọtọ (ozi) ị chọrọ n'ezie iji họpụta verbs nke udi oge gara aga ha na-agwụghị na -ed, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-e4-b06-10.material: N'etiti verbs isii play, go, walk, eat, jump, na see, ịchọrọ ịnakọta naanị verbs nke udi oge gara aga ha na-agwụghị na -ed ma na-agbanwe udi ha.
l-e-e4-b06-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu nwere naanị verbs nke udi ha na-agbanwe?
l-e-e4-b06-10.s.s1.r.b: Atọ niile na-agbakwunye -ed ma ghọọ played, walked, na jumped.
l-e-e4-b06-10.s.s1.explain: Go na-agbanwe gaa n'went, eat na-agbanwe gaa n'ate, ma see na-agbanwe gaa n'saw. Ndị ọzọ na-agbakwunye -ed.
l-e-e4-b06-10.s.s2.model.0: Go, eat, na see na-agbanwe udi dị ka went, ate, na saw, ya mere ha bụ otu verbs na-agbakwunyeghị -ed.
l-e-e4-b06-10.s.s2.model.1: Play, walk, na jump na-agbakwunye -ed, ya mere ha adịghị n'otu nke udi na-agbanwe.

l-e-e4-b07-06.material: Ederede: Mia gara ụlọ ahịa. Ọ zụtara apụl 3 na ube 2. Ọ kwụrụ dollar 5. Ajụjụ: Ube ole ka Mia zụtara?
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s1.prompt: Ozi dị aṅaa ka achọrọ kpamkpam iji zaa ajụjụ ahụ?
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ apụl, ọ bụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ube ajụjụ ahụ jụrụ maka ya.
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Akụkọ banyere ụlọ ahịa ahụ ekwughị ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ.
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s1.r.d: Ego abụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe. Ajụjụ ahụ chọrọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ube.
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s1.explain: Ajụjụ ahụ chọrọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ube. Ya mere ọnụọgụ 2 dị tupu pears na-ekpebi azịza. Ozi ndị ọzọ anaghị ekpebi ya.
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s2.model.0: Ajụjụ ahụ jụrụ ole pears dị, ya mere ọnụọgụ 2 tupu pears dị mkpa kpamkpam. Ọnụọgụ apụl ma ọ bụ ego agaghị enye azịza.
l-e-e4-b07-06.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ajụjụ How many pears; ya mere ị ga-eleba anya n’ọnụọgụ na-akọwa ube. 3 na dollar 5 abụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ ube.

l-e-e4-b01-11.title: Ịsọ ọsọ karịa site n’iwu -er
l-e-e4-b01-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iji atụnyere nkọwa okwu dị mkpirikpi, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b01-11.material: tall → taller, small → smaller, long → longer. Jiri iwu a gbanwee fast (“ngwa ngwa”) ka ọ bụrụ “quicker”.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ okwu e gbanwere dịka iwu ahụ si dị.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: -est pụtara “nke kacha”. Ihe atụ ndị a jiri -er.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: Ihe atụ ndị ahụ ejighị more.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: fastly dị iche n’iwu dị n’ihe atụ ndị ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Ịgbakwunye -er na njedebe nkọwa okwu dị mkpirikpi na-eme ka ọ pụta “karịa”. Maka fast, ọ bụ faster.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: A gbakwụnyere -er na tall, small na long, ya mere fast ga-aghọkwa faster.
l-e-e4-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Ihe atụ atọ ahụ soro iwu ịgbakwunye -er na njedebe, ya mere okwu atụnyere maka fast bụ faster.

l-e-e4-b01-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke preposition e ji tupu oge, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b01-12.material: at 7:00, at noon, on Monday, on Friday, on my birthday. Chọta iwu dị n’ihe atụ ndị a ma mezue ___ Sunday.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: E jiri at na oge elekere dịka 7 o’clock na noon. A naghị eji ya maka ụbọchị izu.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.c: E nweghị in n’ihe atụ ndị ahụ, ya mere ọ bụghị akụkụ iwu ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: to bụ okwu na-adịghị n’ihe atụ ndị ahụ.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Jiri at tupu oge elekere, jiri on tupu ụbọchị izu na ụbọchị kalenda. Sunday bụ ụbọchị izu, ya mere ọ bụ on Sunday.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: on na-abịa tupu ụbọchị izu ọ bụla dịka Monday na Friday; ya mere jiri on tupu Sunday kwa.
l-e-e4-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Iwu ahụ bụ at maka oge elekere na on maka ụbọchị izu, ya mere a na-ekwu on Sunday.

l-e-e4-b01-13.title: Ụdị ngwaa na-eso do not
l-e-e4-b01-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị ngwaa n’ahịrịokwu ọjọọ, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b01-13.material: I do not like tea. / We do not play. / They do not swim. Jiri iwu dị n’ihe atụ ndị a dee “You don’t cook” n’asụsụ Bekee.
l-e-e4-b01-13.s.s1.r.a: N’ihe atụ ndị a, not na-abịa mgbe do gasịrị.
l-e-e4-b01-13.s.s1.r.b: E nweghị are n’ihe atụ ndị a; do not ka a na-eji.
l-e-e4-b01-13.s.s1.explain: “Don’t do something” na-agbaso usoro isiokwu + do not + ngwaa. Dee ngwaa ahụ n’ụdị mgbọrọgwụ ya.
l-e-e4-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: Ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile nwere usoro isiokwu + do not + ngwaa, ya mere You do not cook. ziri ezi.
l-e-e4-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Iwu ya bụ na ngwaa anaghị agbanwe mgbe do not gasịrị, ya mere ọ ga-abụ You do not cook.

l-e-e4-b01-14.title: Gịnị na-abịa mgbe because gasịrị?
l-e-e4-b01-14.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ihe na-abịa mgbe because gasịrị, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b01-14.material: I take an umbrella because it rains. / I wear a coat because it is cold. / I drink water because I am thirsty. Chọta iwu ahụ ma họrọ ihe kpatara ya na I sleep early because I am tired.
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Akụkụ nke na-enye ihe kpatara ya bụ nke?
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s1.r.a: Ihe dị tupu because abụghị ihe kpatara ya, kama ọ bụ ihe e mere.
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ naanị akụkụ ihe e mere, ọ bụghị ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ naanị okwu oge, ọ bụghị ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Ihe kpatara ya na-abịa mgbe because gasịrị. Ihe kpatara i ji arahụ ụra n’oge bụ I am tired (ike gwụrụ m).
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: N’ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile, ihe na-eso because bụ ihe kpatara ya; ya mere I am tired bụ ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Ihe dị tupu because bụ ihe e mere, ihe na-esote ya bụ ihe kpatara ya; ya mere ihe kpatara ịrahụ ụra n’oge bụ I am tired.

l-e-e4-b01-15.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị ngwaa na-abịa mgbe will gasịrị, kwuo iwu ị chọpụtara ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b01-15.material: I will eat lunch. / We will play. / Mina will read. Jiri iwu ahụ mezue Mina ___ visit tomorrow.
l-e-e4-b01-15.s.s1.r.a: tomorrow bụ ihe ga-eme n’ọdịnihu, ya mere ọ bụghị ụdị oge gara aga.
l-e-e4-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: N’ihe atụ ndị ahụ, agbakwụnyeghị -s na will.
l-e-e4-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Ihe ga-eme n’ọdịnihu bụ will + ụdị mgbọrọgwụ ngwaa. Ọbụna ma isiokwu ahụ bụ otu onye, a naghị etinye -s na will.
l-e-e4-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: will dị n’ihe atụ ndị ahụ anaghị agbanwe ụdị ya dabere n’isiokwu, ya mere Mina will visit ziri ezi.
l-e-e4-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: Ụdị mgbọrọgwụ ngwaa na-abịa mgbe will gasịrị, ya mere ọ ga-abụ Mina will visit tomorrow.

l-e-e4-b02-11.title: Iwu nke an apple, an egg, a pen
l-e-e4-b02-11.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke iwu na-ekpebi ma jiri a ma ọ bụ an, kwuo ya, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b02-11.material: an apple, an egg, an elephant / a pen, a dog, a desk. Chọta iwu n'ihe atụ ndị a ma mezuo ___ ant (otu ant).
l-e-e4-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Ihe atụ ndị ahụ anaghị eji the.
l-e-e4-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: A na-eji A mgbe okwu na-amalite na ụda consonant, dị ka pen, dog, desk.
l-e-e4-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Abụọ pụtara abụọ, ọ bụghị otu.

l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Ọ yiri ịgwụ ike, ya mere but na-ada ihe ọjọọ.

l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ otu ihe dị ka akụkụ mbụ, ya mere but na-ada ihe ọjọọ.
l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s1.explain: But na-ejikọta ihe dị iche na akụkụ mbụ. Ịgwụ ike ma ịchọ igwu egwu na-aga n'ntụzi dị iche, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.

l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe but na-abịa ihe megidere akụkụ mbụ, ya mere "I want to play" dabara.

l-e-e4-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe isiokwu bụ karịa otu, iwu bụ are + -ing, ya mere ọ na-abụ "The birds are flying."

l-e-e4-b03-11.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mmegide e mere site n'ịgbakwunye un- tupu okwu, chọta ma kwuo iwu, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b03-11.material: happy → unhappy, kind → unkind, safe → unsafe. Jiri iwu a mee mmegide nke fair.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s1.r.b: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, agbakwunyere un-, ọ bụghị not.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: A na-agbakwunye un- tupu okwu, ọ bụghị mgbe ya.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, agbakwunyere un- tupu okwu. Ọ bụghị no-.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbakwunye un- tupu okwu, ọ na-enweta ihe ọ pụtara megidere. Mmegide nke fair bụ unfair.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: Ihe atụ atọ ahụ na-agbakwunye un- tupu okwu, ya mere fair na-aghọkwa unfair.
l-e-e4-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: un- bụ iwu na-aga n'ihu, ya mere mmegide nke fair bụ unfair.

l-e-e4-b03-12.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ogologo oge a na-ekwu dị ka from 1 to 3, chọta ma kwuo iwu, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b03-12.material: The film is from 1 to 3 (2 hours). The class is from 2 to 5 (3 hours). The game is from 4 to 5 (1 hour). Jiri iwu chọta awa ole bụ from 6 to 9.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: 6 bụ naanị oge mmalite. Ị ga-ewepụrị mmalite site na njedebe.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ uru nke 6 na 9 agbakwunyere. N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, e wepụrụ uru ndị ahụ.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Wepụ oge mmalite site n'oge njedebe. 9 − 6 = 3, ya mere ọ bụ awa 3.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, e wepụrụ mmalite site n'njedebe, dị ka 3 − 1 = 2 na 5 − 2 = 3, ya mere 9 − 6 = awa 3.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Oge njedebe − oge mmalite bụ oge e were, ya mere from 6 to 9 bụ awa 3.

l-e-e4-b07-09.topic: Ụdị oge gara aga nke otu ụdaume na otu mgbochiume
l-e-e4-b07-09.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị oge gara aga na-emegharị mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ, ma nwalee ya n’ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-e4-b07-09.material: stop → stopped, plan → planned, jump → jumped, walk → walked. Tinye -ed na ngwaa iji mee ụdị oge gara aga. Gịnị bụ ụdị oge gara aga nke drop (ịhapụ ihe ka ọ daa)?
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụdị oge gara aga dabara n’iwu ahụ?
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s1.r.b: Dee mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ p ọzọ, dịka stop → stopped.
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dịghị ihe atụ nwere okwu a gbakwụnyere naanị -d. Ha niile nwere -ed.
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dịghị ihe atụ nwere t ọhụrụ a tinyere.
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s1.explain: Ngwaa dị mkpirikpi na-ejedebe na otu ụdaume na otu mgbochiume na-emegharị mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ ya ma tinye -ed. Dị ka stop si aghọ stopped, drop na-aghọ dropped.
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s2.model.0: Ngwaa dị mkpirikpi na-emegharị mkpụrụedemede ikpeazụ, dịka stop → stopped na plan → planned; ya mere drop na-aghọkwa dropped.
l-e-e4-b07-09.s.s2.model.1: Jump na walk nwere mgbochiume abụọ, ya mere ha na-agbakwunye naanị -ed; stop na plan nwere otu mgbochiume, ya mere ha na-emegharị p na n. Ọ bụ ya mere drop ji bụrụ dropped.

l-e-e4-b01-16.title: Ịtụ ogologo oge a ga-ewe iji gụọ ederede
l-e-e4-b01-16.goal: Tụọ ogologo oge a ga-ewe iji gụọ ederede nwere ahịrịokwu 12, kpebie oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b01-16.material: Ederede Bekee ahụ nwere ahịrịokwu 12, ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla nwekwara ihe dị ka okwu 5. Ị na-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 30 n’ime nkeji 1.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Oge kacha daba adaba ịgụ ya bụ ole?
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ okwu 60 na ọsọ okwu 30 n’ime nkeji 1, sekọnd 30 ezughị.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma i tụọ ya naanị, oge nkeji 10 dị ogologo karịa mkpa.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Okwu 60 bụ ihe a ga-agụ n’ugboro abụọ nke okwu 30. Nkeji 5 dị ogologo karịa.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu 12 × okwu 5 = okwu 60. Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ okwu 30 n’ime nkeji 1, 60 ÷ 30 = nkeji 2.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: 12 × 5 bụ okwu 60; ebe ị na-agụ okwu 30 n’ime nkeji 1, ọ ga-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 2.
l-e-e4-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: Ịgụ okwu 60 na ọsọ okwu 30 n’otu nkeji bụ ugboro abụọ; ya mere nkeji 2 dabara.

l-e-e4-b02-19.goal: Tụọ oge ọ ga-ewe iji gụọ akwụkwọ akụkọ peeji 40 ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-agụ peeji 8 kwa ụbọchị; họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.

l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s1.prompt: Ụbọchị ole ka ọ ga-ewe iji gụchaa ya?
l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s1.r.a: N'ime ụbọchị 3 ị ga-agụ naanị peeji 24.
l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s1.r.d: A gbakọrọ ụbọchị 32 n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi, dịka a ga-asị na a na-agbakwunye ọnụ ọgụgụ peeji.
l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s1.explain: 40 ÷ 8 = 5, ya mere ọ ga-ewe ụbọchị 5. Ụbọchị 5 × peeji 8 = peeji 40.
l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s2.model.0: Peeji 8 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 5 bụ peeji 40, ya mere ọ ga-ewe ụbọchị 5.
l-e-e4-b02-19.s.s2.model.1: 40 ekewara na 8 bụ 5, ya mere ị ga-agụ ya ụbọchị 5.

l-e-e4-b03-20.goal: Mgbe taa bụ Friday, tụ anya ụbọchị atọ gara aga iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e4-b03-20.material: Taa bụ Friday. Otu enyi sịrị, 'I saw a movie three days ago.'
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụbọchị enyi ahụ hụrụ ihe nkiri?
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: Wednesday bụ ụbọchị abụọ gara aga.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: Thursday bụ ụbọchị otu gara aga.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: Monday bụ ụbọchị anọ gara aga.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s1.explain: Site na Friday, otu ụbọchị tupu bụ Thursday, ụbọchị abụọ tupu bụ Wednesday, ma ụbọchị atọ tupu bụ Tuesday.
l-e-e4-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: Ịgụ azụ ugboro atọ site na Friday na-enye Tuesday, ya mere ụbọchị atọ gara aga bụ Tuesday.

l-e-e4-b04-16.title: Ọnụọgụ adjectives e cheta n'izu 4
l-e-e4-b04-16.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ adjectives ọhụrụ e cheta n'izu 4, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-e4-b04-16.material: I na-echeta adjectives ọhụrụ 6 n'ụbọchị. Ọ bụrụ na ị chetara n'efughị ụbọchị ọ bụla maka izu 4 (ụbọchị 28), tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ole ị ga-enwe n'ozuzu.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ adjectives e cheta n'izu 4 kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ banyere icheta 6 n'ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 5 naanị. Ụbọchị 28 dị ọtụtụ karịa.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ 6×100. Ụbọchị 28 abụghị ụbọchị 100.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu. 6 okpukpu 28 anaghị erukwa 200.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s1.explain: 6 × 28 bụ ihe dị ka 170, ntakịrị n'okpuru 6 × 30. Kpọmkwem, ọ bụ 168.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s2.model.0: Na 6 n'ụbọchị, ụbọchị 28 ka a na-eme atụmatụ dịka ụbọchị 30, na-enye ihe dị ka 180, ya mere ihe dị ka 170 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-e4-b04-16.s.s2.model.1: 6 × 28 = 168, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 170, nhọrọ ndị ọzọ dịkwa ntakịrị ma ọ bụ buru ibu nke ukwuu.

l-e-e4-b04-17.material: Otu peeji nke akwụkwọ eserese nwere okwu 40. N'ime ha, 8 bụ okwu ọnọdụ dịka in, on, na under. Tụọ atụmatụ na okwu ọnọdụ bụ ihe dị ka 1 n'ime okwu ole.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ole nke ihe niile bụ okwu ọnọdụ?
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ pụtara ihe dị ka okwu 20. 8 dị ole na ole karịa nke ahụ.

l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ pụtara 1 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị n'ime okwu 40, nke dị ole na ole nke ukwuu.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa ihe 40 n'otu 5, otu ọ bụla nwere ihe 8. Ya mere ihe 8 bụ 1/5 nke ihe niile.
l-e-e4-b04-17.s.s2.model.0: 40 kewara site na 8 bụ 5, ya mere okwu ọnọdụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/5 nke ihe niile.

l-e-e4-b04-20.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ dị ọtụtụ nke ukwuu. Ahịrịokwu 5 na-ejide ole na ole karịa.
l-e-e4-b04-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ okwu n'otu ahịrịokwu. Maka ahịrịokwu 5, ọ na-aghọ okpukpu 5.
l-e-e4-b04-20.s.s1.explain: 6 × 5 = 30 na 10 × 5 = 50. Ya mere ahịrịokwu 5 nwere ihe dị ka okwu 30~50.
l-e-e4-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: Otu ahịrịokwu nwere okwu 6~10 ma e nwere ahịrịokwu 5, ya mere 6 × 5 na 10 × 5 na-enye okwu 30~50.

l-e-e4-b05-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ karịrị oke ugboro 10. Otu peeji nwere ihe dị ka okwu 100.

l-e-e4-b06-19.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ Bekee n'ụlọ akwụkwọ akwụkwọ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe mere.
l-e-e4-b06-19.material: Obere ụlọ akwụkwọ akwụkwọ nwere ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 480. Ihe dị ka 1/5 nke ha bụ akwụkwọ Bekee. Tụ anya ihe dị ka akwụkwọ Bekee ole dị.
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ Bekee kwesịrị ekwesị?
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ maka ọkara (1/2). 1/5 pere mpe karịa nke ahụ.
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/50. 1/5 buru ibu karịa nke ahụ nke ukwuu.
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee 480 ka ọ bụrụ 500, 500 ÷ 5 = 100, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 100.
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee 480 ka ọ bụrụ 500 ma kewaa site na 5, ị na-enweta 100, ya mere e nwere ihe dị ka akwụkwọ Bekee 100.
l-e-e4-b06-19.s.s2.model.1: 1/5 bụ otu n'otu 5 hà nhata, ya mere 1/5 nke akwụkwọ 480 bụ ihe dị ka akwụkwọ 100.

l-e-e4-b07-05.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ahịa pensụl anọ ka i kpebie oke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b07-05.material: Ị jụrụ n’ụlọ ahịa, “How much is a pen?” Azịza ya bụ “It’s 1 dollar 95 cents.” Ị chọrọ ịtụ azịza ajụjụ gị bụ “How much are four pens?”

l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s1.r.a: O weere otu pensụl dịka nke karịrị dollar 2 nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ dị oke ọnụ.
l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: O weere otu pensụl dịka dollar 1 na cents 50, ya mere ọ dị ọnụ ala.
l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s1.r.d: O gbadara ọnụ ahịa otu pensụl ka ọ bụrụ dollar 1, ya mere ọ dị ọnụ ala nke ukwuu.
l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s1.explain: 1 dollar 95 cents dị nso na dollar 2. Pensụl 4, nke dollar 2 nke ọ bụla, ga-abụ ihe dị ka dollar 8.
l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: 1 dollar 95 cents dị nso na dollar 2; ya mere pensụl 4 ga-abụ ihe dị ka dollar 8, site na 2×4.
l-e-e4-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Otu pensụl dị ntakịrị ọnụ ala karịa dollar 2, ya mere a ga-atụ anya na pensụl anọ ga-efu ihe dị ka dollar 8, ntakịrị n’okpuru dollar 8.

l-e-e4-b05-22.title: Oge ole ka klaasị ga-agwụ? Ebee ka o si gaa ezighi ezi?

l-e-e4-b05-24.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ ọnụọgụ sitere n'ederede ahụ.
l-e-e4-b05-24.s.s1.o.b: ② Apụl ndị e riri bụ 2 + 1 = 3
l-e-e4-b05-24.s.s1.r.b: Nchikọta ihe Tom na Ana riri ziri ezi.
l-e-e4-b05-24.s.s1.explain: Iri nri na-eme ka ha ghara ịdị ọtụtụ, ya mere ọ bụ 5 - 3 = 2. E nwere apụl 2 fọdụrụ.

l-e-e4-b04-29.goal: Gbanwee isi echiche nke obere ederede banyere bees ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-e-e4-b04-29.material: Bees visit flowers. They drink a sweet juice called nectar. They carry pollen to other flowers. This helps plants make seeds. Mee ka isi echiche nke ederede a dị mkpụmkpụ n'otu ahịrịokwu.

l-e-e4-b04-29.s.s1.explain: Bees carry pollen and help plants make seeds. Nke a bụ isi echiche na-ejikọta ederede niile.
l-e-e4-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Bees na-aga gburugburu n'flowers ma buru pollen, ya mere ahịrịokwu na-ekwu na ha na-enyere osisi aka ime mkpụrụ bụ isi echiche.

l-e-e4-b06-35.s.s1.r.b: Jiri -ing mgbe ị na-eme ihe ugbu a. Ọ bụghị maka ihe ị na-eme mgbe niile.
l-e-e4-b06-35.s.s1.r.c: B pụtara na ị na-eme ya ugbu a.
l-e-e4-b06-35.s.s1.r.d: A bụ udi ziri ezi maka ikwu banyere omenaala.
l-e-e4-b06-35.s.s1.explain: Ihe ị na-eme kwa Sunday bụ omenaala, ya mere kwuo I play soccer. I am playing pụtara na ị na-eme ya ugbu a.
l-e-e4-b06-35.s.s2.model.0: Ihe ị na-eme kwa Sunday bụ omenaala, ya mere A, nke na-eji udi ugbu a, bụ nke ziri ezi.

l-e-e4-b07-03.topic: any na no n’ahịrịokwu nwere not
l-e-e4-b07-03.goal: Tụlee ụzọ abụọ isi jiri any na no n’ahịrịokwu nwere not, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-e4-b07-03.material: Ị na-ekwu na pensụl adịghị gị. A: I don’t have any pens. B: I don’t have no pens. Họrọ ahịrịokwu dabara n’ụlọ akwụkwọ Bekee.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu dabara adaba karịa, gịnịkwa mere?
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.o.a: A: E nwere not, ya mere jiri any
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.o.b: B: Jiri no mee ka okwu ahụ sie ike karịa
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na i jiri not na no ọnụ, ị na-akwakọba okwu ọjọọ, ọ na-ada ụda iju n’asụsụ Bekee ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ dabara, ihe ha pụtakwara bụ otu.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.r.c: B nwere okwu ọjọọ abụọ a chịkọtara ọnụ, ya mere ọ dabaghị n’asụsụ Bekee ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: A bụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi nke jiri any mgbe not gasịrị.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e nwere not, jiri any ma kwuo “any pens”. Ọ bụrụ na i jiri not na no ọnụ, okwu ọjọọ na-agbakọta ọnụ ma na-ada iju.
l-e-e4-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: Don’t adịlarị njọ, ya mere ị ga-eji any n’azụ ya, ọ bụghị no. Ọ bụ ya mere A ji ziri ezi.
